02 · About me

A little about myself ✿

I'm Khristel Eleisa Mores, an Information Technology student at Mindoro State University with a passion for exploring technology, coding, and digital art. I enjoy learning how things work, discovering new ideas, and developing my skills. I'm particularly interested in web development and creating simple, user-friendly digital experiences that combine creativity and functionality.

♡ Experience

My experience so far comes from school activities and personal practice in coding and drawing. I enjoy writing code, working through programming exercises, and creating drawings. Both allow me to turn ideas into something of my own while continuously learning and improving.

☘ Background

I'm interested in two things: drawing and coding. Drawing lets me express my ideas creatively, while coding challenges me to think logically and solve problems. I enjoy practicing both and finding ways to improve with every attempt.

✎ Education

Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT) student at Mindoro State University. I'm building my foundation in programming and developing the technical skills needed for coding.

✧ What I'm learning

I'm working to improve my coding skills through programming logic, writing and understanding code, debugging, and practicing with C, C#, HTML, and CSS. I'm also developing my drawing skills through regular practice with sketching, line art, coloring, shading, and creating clearer, more detailed artwork.

Little note: This portfolio focuses on my learning journey and school projects. More details and new work will be added as I continue growing.
